name: apple-pro-display-xdr
title: Studio Display Mockup
description: A photorealistic studio display on a dark backdrop, with a camera dot, a slim stand and a macOS-style dock of app icons. The dock magnifies under the pointer with tooltips, and clicking the screen swaps the wallpaper for a dark app view.
use: A portfolio or product page wants a realistic desktop screen to showcase an app or wallpaper in a hero.
avoid: It is heavy with inline SVG art and hardcoded aluminium tones, so it suits a showcase rather than a themeable layout.
a11y: Dock icons and the cable hole are labelled, but the clickable screen has no keyboard route to change modes. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A silver aluminium monitor with a thin black bezel and a slim stand centred on near-black. Its screen shows a mountain wallpaper above a translucent dock of colourful round-square app icons; the frame carries a soft tinted glow when active.
behaves: Pointing at the dock swells the icons and pops a small tooltip above them while a coloured glow rings the display. Clicking the screen advances to the next demo, swapping the wallpaper for a dark player window.
customise: initialMode picks the first screen demo and screenContent swaps in your own screen; the aluminium tones, dock icons and glow colours are hardcoded in the source.
weight: moderate: Lots of inline SVG and gradient layers; springs run only on dock hover and mode change.
demo: A mountain-and-cloud wallpaper with a dock of app icons, then a dark window with a blue-orange gradient.
issues: Nothing signals that the screen is clickable to switch modes.
The dock icons and tooltip text are very small at this scale.
polishWhy: Convincing aluminium display with a live dock; the screen is undiscoverable and controls are tiny.
